list.definition:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    (${__to:date:seconds} - ${__from:date:seconds}) AS range_seconds,
    '${enable_history:csv}' = 'true' AS is_history
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN is_history AND range_seconds >= 3600 THEN GREATEST(900, CEIL(range_seconds / 50.0))
    WHEN range_seconds <= 300  THEN range_seconds/10
    WHEN range_seconds <= 900  THEN range_seconds/20
    WHEN range_seconds <= 1800 THEN range_seconds/30
    WHEN range_seconds <= 3600 THEN range_seconds/40
    ELSE range_seconds/50
  END AS bucket_seconds
FROM params
